text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Friday:
- The Swiss government chose Professor Jean-Francois Bergier to be president of the nine-member expert commission investigating Nazi gold and funds of Holocaust victims in the country.
- Swissair management announced the creation of a new holding structure named SAirGroup, which will head four sections: SAirLines, SAirServices, SAir Logistics and SAirRelations.
- Union Bank of Switzerland and UBS Italia S.p.A. opened a new subsidiary in Milan.
- The number of countries boycotting Swiss beef has risen to 22.
- Germany's Viag Group confirmed its interest in a partnership with Watt AG, a subsidiary of Elektrowatt.
- The component sector of Alcatel Schweiz AG will be taken over by its management.
- The number of people addicted to drugs in Switzerland since the start of the decade has stabilized at around 30,000.
